statement.text: Main aise interfaces banata hoon jo clever lagne se pehle
mehsoos hon, aur har us shakhs ko

beats.text: Shuruaat IBA Karachi se hui, computer science ki degree ke saath.
Main jaanna chahta tha ke meri screen par cheezein asal mein kaise kaam karti hain.
Kazakhstan ki Ministry of Education ke liye ek learning platform: pehli baar anjaan logon ne meri banayi hui cheez istemaal ki.
React samajh mein aaya, aur interfaces woh cheez ban gaye jin ke baare mein main sochna band nahi kar saka.
Flutter ne wohi tawajjoh phones tak pohanchayi.
Tab se 3+ saal se main hukoomaton, industry aur apne products ke liye React aur TypeScript ship kar raha hoon.
Main design file aur us cheez ke darmiyan rehta hoon jise log chhoote hain: motion, states, edge cases, accessibility.
Jab koi cheez chal jaaye, to main jaanna chahta hoon kyun. Jab na chale, to aur bhi jaldi.

work.label: CHUNEEDA KAAM
work.heading: Kaam
work.hint: Projects ke darmiyan jaane ke liye scroll karein. Aap ka cursor roshni hai.

projects.name: SCEAI Platform
projects.summary: Qatar ki Supreme Council of Economic Affairs ka platform, jo His Highness Emir-e-Qatar istemaal karte hain. Main ne is ke 9 core frontend modules ki architecture banayi.

highlights.text: 6 hafton mein 366 ghante, aur national deadline par sirf mere modules bug-free
Store ki nayi tarteeb se load time ~25% kam hua

projects.name: AccurateSpend
projects.summary: Pharma aur biotech companies ke liye compliance SaaS, jo CMS Open Payments (Sunshine Act) reporting ko data intake se submission tak automate karta hai.

highlights.text: 8 modules, 60+ components, 3–4 mahine ke andaaze ke muqable mein taqreeban 3 hafton mein
Validation engine jo har payment record ko CMS rules par parakhta hai

projects.name: Protocoling Suite
projects.summary: Kazakhstan Petrochemical Industries ke liye AI suite, jo English, Kazakh aur Russian mein guftagu ko live transcribe karta hai aur phir us ka khulasa banata hai.

highlights.text: Browser se Whisper API tak chunked audio upload
MIME filtering, RBAC aur protected routes ke saath mehfooz file handling

projects.name: KunARCHGPT
projects.summary: UK ke architectural qawaneen ke baare mein sawalon ke jawab dene wala AI chatbot, paid tiers aur usage dashboard ke saath.

highlights.text: Query limits aur SendGrid emails ke saath tiered Stripe subscriptions
OAuth 2.0 par Google aur Microsoft sign-in

process.label: MAIN KAISE KAAM KARTA HOON
process.heading: Tareeqa
process.hint: Kaghaz tah karne ke liye scroll karein. Aap ka cursor roshni hai.

steps.name: Khoj
steps.summary: Main pehle masla samajhta hoon: ye kis ke liye hai, kamyabi kaisi dikhti hai, aur raaste mein kya aa sakta hai.

steps.name: Khaaka
steps.summary: Code likhne se pehle main dhaancha banata hoon aur ahem screens aur interactions ka khaaka tayyar karta hoon.

steps.name: Tameer
steps.summary: Main ise chhote, test kiye hue hisson mein banata hoon, aur saath saath performance aur accessibility check karta hoon.

steps.name: Nikhaar
steps.summary: Main asli devices par asli logon ke saath test karta hoon, phir tafseelat ko tab tak sanwaarta hoon jab tak sab theek na lage.

steps.name: Launch
steps.summary: Main ise launch karta hoon, dekhta hoon ke ye kaisa chal raha hai, aur launch ke baad bhi behtar karta rehta hoon.
